subject: Why every automated probe of the reported www.douyin.com/follow -> live room badge-sync route was invalid, and where the static badge-creation chain breaks
warning: This file records an ENVIRONMENT FAILURE and a STATIC code finding. It contains NO valid real-site evidence for the reported route. Do not cite any badge number from this batch as proof.

environment.loading: production dist via CDP Extensions.loadUnpacked into a headful real Chrome with a throwaway profile copy
environment.input: real trusted mouse events only (no synthetic dispatchEvent)

rootCauseOfInvalidProbes.finding: Chrome 157 App-Bound Encryption makes a byte copy of Default/Network/Cookies undecryptable, so every throwaway profile copy was signed OUT, not signed in.

throwawayCopy.documentCookieNote: All 31 are freshly written by the Douyin SDK after page load; none are the original login cookies.
throwawayCopy.followVisibleText: 开启读屏标签…精选推荐AI抖音关注朋友我的直播…登录后即可关注扫码登录如何扫码打开「抖音APP」…验证码登录密码登录
throwawayCopy.followFeedApi: https://www.douyin.com/aweme/v1/web/follow/feed/ returned HTTP 200 but the follow feed did not render

rootCauseOfInvalidProbes.correction: An earlier interim claim that the /follow feed 'never rendered because only Cookies were copied' was wrong. Copying Local Storage / IndexedDB / WebStorage does NOT fix it; the login cookies themselves are v20-encrypted and lost. A 300-character body sample also looked empty because inline <script> text dominates body.textContent, so it must never be used as a feed-render oracle.

failedRemedy.approach: Export clear cookie values from the real signed-in Chrome via CDP Storage.getCookies and inject them into the throwaway copy with Network.setCookies (values kept in process memory only).
failedRemedy.result: Puppeteer 25.16.0 BrowserLauncher.js:227 raises 'The browser is already running for <real profile>'. On Windows this is a ProcessSingleton false positive: Chrome logs 'Failed to create a ProcessSingleton for your profile directory', Puppeteer sees a writable directory and blames a running browser.
failedRemedy.verification: No chrome.exe processes alive and <real profile>/lockfile did not exist, yet two consecutive launches were rejected. Passing --user-data-dir as a raw Chrome arg does not bypass the check.

routeFacts.followPageLivePlayer: LivePlayer_PreCreatePlayer douyin-player is present even while signed out, with text '直播加载中'

afterLiveTab.myFollowLiveText: 暂时没有关注的人在直播

routeFacts.conclusion: The signed-out copy cannot reach the logged-in same-origin /follow SPA route that the report describes; the reachable route is a cross-origin portal hop, which was already measured in earlier rounds and does NOT reproduce the symptom.

popupFact.observation: Opening popup.html on the unauthenticated /follow page rendered btn-pin, btn-close-panel and a row of sp-btn icon buttons, but NO .btn-pause / playback button.
popupFact.meaning: The reported 'press popup pause/play once' gesture cannot even be issued in this environment, so phase B of every probe was structurally invalid.

chain: 2814-2817: a page observation whose target documentId differs from baseline throws 'Physical page observation belongs to a stale document' before any badge work.
2826-2831: if (!mediaSampleCanReplace(...) && !sameSelection || isRetiredMediaSample(...)) the function RETURNS EARLY with empty fields.
2839-2842: markBadgeUsedForTab(request.tabId) — the ONLY page-side path allowed by I10 to create durable badge usage — sits AFTER both gates.
staticCodeFinding.consequence: After an SPA route/player swap, if the first trusted-gesture volume observation is judged an older sample or a retired source, the trusted-input witness reaches the background but never earns badge usage. projectBadgeFromSnapshot (line 1057) then drops the projection at the observationOnly gate, so the badge stays empty.

unblockPathsExplainThemselves.popupPausePlay: recordSuccessfulExtensionUse / scheduleSuccessfulExtensionUse (line 2740 / 2803) call markBadgeUsedForTab directly, bypassing page-observation admission; thereafter the observationOnly gate admits refinements.
unblockPathsExplainThemselves.reload: a fresh document rebuilds baseline/mediaObservation ownership and re-injects content scripts, so the first observation is no longer stale or retired.

staticCodeFinding.priorArt: apps/extension-spectra/src/background/handlers/badge.ts lines 193-214 (isSupersededPresentation) already names 'the badge only follows after I open the Popup or pause and play once' symptom, but that fix is in the badge presentation layer, not in the observation admission layer above.
staticCodeFinding.status: STATIC INFERENCE ONLY. Not confirmed on the reported route. No product code was changed in this round.

proved div.tab-live is a cross-origin whole-document navigation, not the reported SPA route

real-profile ProcessSingleton false positive on clear-cookie export

signed out; markerCard mis-selected div.douyin-player-loading ('直播加载中'); click did not change URL; no second-hop room link; all three phases dragOk=false; popupGesture.ok=false; sampleValid=false; reportedRouteExact=false

conclusion: This round produced NO valid real-site evidence for the reported route. It did establish why earlier /follow probe batches were invalid (v20 ABE signed-out copies) and it located a concrete static break point in the badge-creation chain. The reported symptom remains UNVERIFIED and UNFIXED.
notProven: That the /follow -> /follow/live/<id> same-origin SPA route exists in the signed-in state.
That the first trusted volume observation is actually rejected after that SPA swap.
That moving or duplicating badge-usage creation before the admission gates fixes the symptom without breaking I10.
Any claim that this batch reproduces or eliminates the badge-sync symptom.
nextStep: Take evidence on the user's own signed-in Chrome 157 (which already has the workspace dist 1.4.2 installed) by starting it with a remote debugging port and attaching over CDP, instead of copying the profile.

On that session, drive: /follow -> real click on an in-feed live avatar -> zero-extension-gesture native volume drag, and record badgeText / spectra.badge.used.<tabId> / snapshot / content runtime status / trusted-input witness as one timeline.
Only after that timeline confirms the static break point, make the smallest product change and re-run the same gated real-site case plus the isolated unit tests.
